# Contributing to DStats

First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! ❤️

All types of contributions are encouraged and valued. Whether you're fixing a bug, suggesting a feature, improving the project, or helping with code, your contribution is appreciated.

## Table of Contents

- [Questions](#questions)
- [Reporting Bugs](#reporting-bugs)
- [Suggesting Enhancements](#suggesting-enhancements)
- [Making a Contribution](#making-a-contribution)
- [Commit Messages](#commit-messages)

## Questions

Before asking a question, please search the existing [Issues](https://github.com/ViB404/dstats/issues) to see if someone has already asked about the same problem.

If you still need help:

- Open a [new issue](https://github.com/ViB404/dstats/issues/new).
- Provide as much context as possible.
- Include relevant project, platform, and package manager versions.

## Reporting Bugs

Before submitting a bug report:

- Make sure you are using the latest version.
- Check the existing [issues](https://github.com/ViB404/dstats/issues) to make sure the bug has not already been reported.
- Make sure the issue is reproducible.
- Include relevant environment information.
- Include logs, screenshots, or other useful information when applicable.

### Security Issues

**Do not report security vulnerabilities or sensitive security issues through public GitHub issues.**

Please report security vulnerabilities privately by emailing:

**[hi@heyvib.in](mailto:hi@heyvib.in)**

Include as much relevant information as possible so that the issue can be investigated.

### How to Submit a Bug Report

We use GitHub Issues to track bugs and errors.

When submitting a bug report:

- Explain the expected behaviour.
- Explain the actual behaviour.
- Provide clear steps to reproduce the issue.
- Include relevant logs, screenshots, or other context.
- Include your environment and version information where applicable.

## Suggesting Enhancements

Feature requests and improvements are tracked through GitHub Issues.

Before submitting an enhancement:

- Check the existing [issues](https://github.com/ViB404/dstats/issues) to see if the idea has already been suggested.
- Make sure the suggestion fits the scope of DStats.
- Clearly explain the problem your suggestion would solve.

When submitting an enhancement:

- Use a clear and descriptive title.
- Describe the proposed behaviour.
- Explain the current behaviour and what you would like to change.
- Explain why the enhancement would be useful.
- Include screenshots or examples when they help explain the idea.

## Making a Contribution

### Getting Started

Clone the repository and install the dependencies using pnpm:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ViB404/dstats.git
cd dstats
pnpm install
```

Use the development commands defined in the project's `package.json` to run, check, lint, test, or build the project.

### Pull Requests

When opening a pull request:

- Keep the pull request focused on a single change.
- Clearly describe what the pull request changes and why.
- Make sure your changes are tested.
- Make sure existing functionality is not unnecessarily broken.
- Keep commits clear and relevant.
- Update related code or configuration when necessary.

## Commit Messages

Use clear and descriptive commit messages.

Where possible, use conventional prefixes such as:

- `feat:` — new feature
- `fix:` — bug fix
- `docs:` — documentation changes
- `refactor:` — code restructuring
- `chore:` — maintenance changes
- `test:` — test changes

Example:

```text
feat: add command tracking
fix: handle failed API requests
docs: update contributing guide
```

Thanks for helping make DStats better!
